summary: The control node can be almost any UNIX-like machine with Python, including RHEL, Debian, Ubuntu, macOS, BSDs and Windows via WSL; native Windows isn't supported.
questions: Which operating systems can run the Ansible control node?
Can I run Ansible on macOS?
Can I use WSL as an Ansible control node?

answer_card.title: Control node requirements
answer_card.answer_md: Almost any UNIX-like machine with Python: Red Hat, Debian, Ubuntu, macOS, BSDs, and Windows **under WSL**. Windows without WSL isn't supported as a control node.
